title: 托福官方套题 15 · 口语

tasks.sample: Begin by choosing a bike from the station.
Use the payment stand to pay for your rental.
Refer to the map for information on nearby routes.
Return the vehicle to any open space available.
Locks are necessary to prevent any potential theft.
Perform a quality check and resolve any issues before starting your ride.
Follow all traffic rules, and remember that you are required to wear a helmet.

tasks.stem: Thank you for joining the study. I'd like to ask you about your attitudes toward education. Could you describe a class or subject you have found interesting?
Great. Do you prefer studying alone, or do you find it more effective to study in groups? Why?

Interesting. Some people believe that governments should provide free university education for everyone in the country who wants it. Others say it’s not something that governments should pay for. What do you think? Why?
Good points. I just have one more question. Looking to the future, if education becomes more virtual, how do you think that will affect how students interact and learn together?
